usage: xo serve [--socket=path] [stop|status]

Keep checked programs in memory and answer xo check and xo query over a
unix socket (default $XO_SERVE_SOCKET or <user cache dir>/xo/serve.sock).
check, query, and, inside a module, def, refs, type, symbols and doc use
a running server automatically; an answer is reused until a file under
the module root or std changes. XO_NO_SERVE=1 turns that off. stop shuts
the server down; status prints its cache counters.
